title: Wayfare Pass Plan Schedule — Wayfare Pro Correction Relief
content:
# Wayfare Pro correction relief — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

When Pass ride credit is clawed back from a Wayfare Pass member because a fare was reduced by a fare adjustment, the Wayfare Pro correction relief follows the Wayfare Pro status on the member's own driver earnings account: 20 percent at Wayfare Pro Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite, 10 percent at Wayfare Pro Gold or Silver, nothing at Wayfare Pro Blue or without an earnings account.

| Wayfare Pro status on the member's own earnings account in Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro | Relief |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 20 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 20 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 20 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 10 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 10 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | nothing |
| no earnings account | nothing |

**Effect.** The relief takes that percentage of the clawed-back credit on the trip off the credit correction. The percentage is of the clawed-back credit itself; the credit correction never goes below 0.00, and it is rounded half up to the cent once the relief is taken off.

**Whose account.** Only the earnings account belonging to the member, on the same customer profile, with the Wayfare Pro status it carries for the quarter.

**Figure (hypothetical).** A member at Wayfare Pro Platinum with 0.36 clawed back has 0.072 taken off; the correction is 0.288, rounded to 0.29.
